verdict.rationale: Skyfire documents a public REST API with reference pages for charging tokens, introspecting tokens, wallet balance, agent source IPs, and organization seller-agent creation, authenticated with per-agent keys in the skyfire-api-key header. A live probe confirmed the token API is running and key-gated as documented, and llms.txt is served publicly. Missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI spec at any probed path, and some setup (API key creation, seller service creation and approval) is shown only through the dashboard rather than the API.
